subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be permanently denied from patching legacy ownerless rows, and what supported recovery path should operators use?
rationale: The fail-closed upgrade behavior affects persisted sessions and requires an explicit security and compatibility policy choice.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and ship a documented or automated operator recovery path before merge.

options.title: Temporary compatibility path
options.body: Preserve narrowly scoped ownerless access until ownership migration is available.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and ship a documented or automated operator recovery path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest feature-history signal across the central session storage and Gateway mutation files.
